scope: Universal one-step fixed-size polynomial determinant theorem; actual S5 last input only. No defined all-m family, every-input degree/symmetry/irreducibility, m>4 zero-sum equivalence, solving-degree, complexity, signed or separate-host conclusion.
statement: For the actual fixed-size resultant step Res_(D,2)(f,S3), over any commutative coefficient ring with natDegree(f)<=D, the coefficient of T^(2D) is f(Z)^2 and degree is at most2D; for a domain and nonzero f the degree is exactly2D. Resetting D from2to0 for f=1 changes the actual resultant. Applying the step to canonical S4 with independent formal inputs gives canonical S5 last-input degree8 over every field.
